title: Token slotting and bucketized econ playbook
content:
Purpose:
Quick working spreadsheet + recommendations for a bucketed approach to token-level unit economics and model slotting for Hosted API. This is a working playbook: high-level hypotheses, spreadsheet snapshots (text), sensitivity knobs, and short experiments to validate. Focus: reduce marginal per-token COGS while preserving latency SLO for common slices.

Summary (TL;DR):
- Problem: per-token COGS varies widely by model family and region; customers mix short-chat bursts and long-generation jobs causing suboptimal placement.
- Proposal: define 3 token buckets (burst/low-seq, medium, long/expensive) and slot models into capacity pools with matching batch/caching policies.
- Expected impact (rough): 12–28% unit-cost reduction across mixed workloads after 3 experiments (slotting + aggressive KV-caching + 10–20% batch window tuning).

Key assumptions (spreadsheet inputs):
- Baseline GPU rates (hourly) by region: us-west1-gpu-v100: $2.40/hr, eu-west1-gpu-a100: $3.10/hr, asia-east1-gpu-a10: $1.75/hr. (source: infra-ratecard Q3 2024)
- Average tokens/sec per GPU per model: small-embed: 1200 tps, 7B: 600 tps, 13B: 320 tps, 70B: 80 tps (batching=auto baseline).
- Average effective tokens per request distribution (hosted API): 60% <=64 tokens, 30% 64–512 tokens, 10% >512 tokens.
- Networking + storage overhead add ~6% to token COGS baseline for hosted serving.
- Target margin bands: self-serve (35–50%), paying scale (20–35%).

Spreadsheet snapshot (textual tables — these refer to tabs in the sheet):
- Tab: inputs
  - region, gpu_hour, gpu_type, avg_tps_13B, avg_tps_7B, avg_tps_small, net_overhead_pct
  - us-west1, 2.40, v100, 320, 600, 1200, 6%
  - eu-west1, 3.10, a100, 340, 620, 1250, 6%
  - asia-east1, 1.75, a10, 300, 560, 1100, 6%
- Tab: per_token_compute_cost (formula notes)
  - compute_cost_per_token = gpu_hour / (avg_tps * 3600)  // simple compute share per token
  - add net_overhead_pct and amortized infra (hosted control plane) = +0.0000008 token (example)
- Tab: model_family_slices
  - family, typical_context, baseline_batch_window_ms, kv_cache_hit_rate_guess
  - 7B, 512, 20, 12%
  - 13B, 1024, 40, 8%
  - 70B, 8192, 80, 4%

Bucket definitions (operational):
- Bucket A — Burst / low-seq (<=64 tokens)
  - SLO: p99 <= 120ms; aggressive batching allowed; maintain small prefix-cache MLPs; target model families: small and 7B for chat.
  - Policies: route to shared cheapest GPU pools (burst pools), apply short batch windows (10–25ms), enable prefix KV caching for repeated short prompts.
- Bucket B — Mid (65–512 tokens)
  - SLO: p99 <= 350ms; medium batch windows (30–60ms), higher resource pinning for 13B.
- Bucket C — Long / high cost (>512 tokens)
  - SLO: p99 <= 1.2s; send to dedicated or reserved capacity where throughput predictable; larger batching 80–120ms; enable large KV caches for reuse.

Slotting recommendations (how to place models):
- Small family (<=7B): default to shared burst pools in us-west1 + asia-east1; favor cheaper GPUs for short contexts.
- Mid family (13B): primarily dedicated pool in eu-west1 + us-west1 for predictable margin; allow spillover to burst during low-util.
- Large family (70B+): strict reserved capacity; require commit pricing or higher tier.

Cost math examples (from the sheet):
- Example: us-west1 13B compute_cost_per_token = 2.40 / (320 * 3600) = $0.0000020833 per token compute-only. +6% net => $0.000002208 per token. Add amortization & infra => ~$0.0000029 token.
- For 1M tokens on 13B in us-west1 => ~$2.9 compute+infra. If we can batch more (increase avg_tps to 380) => cost -> $2.44 (16% saving).

Sensitivity knobs and quick experiments (prioritized):
1) Batch window tuning experiment (A/B): increase batch window in Bucket A from 20ms -> 35ms for 48h on 20% traffic; measure p99 and unit cost. Jira: JIRA-OPT-4312, owner: Ethan.
2) KV caching pilot for common prefixes: instrument top-50 prompts and enable prefix cache for 7B family for 7 days; measure cache hit rate and token savings. Owner: Jamal.
3) Regional slotting test: route 15% eu traffic of 13B requests to us-west1 reserved pool (cost and latency tradeoffs) for 72h. Owner: Priya.

Expected measurements (metrics to capture in sheet):
- tokens_served, tokens_cached, effective_tps, p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU_util, infra_cost_total, per_token_cogs, margin_pct_by_plan.

Draft recommendations (short-term / quick wins):
- Implement bucket-A batch tuning + KV-caching pilot (both low infra risk) — expected 8–12% immediate reduction on mixed chat workloads.
- Start 13B reserved-pool sizing exercise for eu-west1 (commit/discount calculus) to lock 10–15% of peak 13B traffic.
- Add per-route tagging (route->bucket) in console so customers can see cost impact and opt-in for cheaper buckets.

Longer term hypotheses (needs data):
- Hypothesis: Slotting by bucket and model family reduces tail latency variance and enables 18–28% median per-token cost reduction when combined with cache-aware routing and per-route shaping.
- Need: 30-day experiment with realistic traffic shaping and cost attribution (use existing billing tables + trace-level allocation).

Open questions / TODOs:
- How to price route-level bucket opt-ins (discount vs. SLO delta)? economics/ pricing input needed (link to pricing doc in linked_artifacts).
- Estimate churn/UX impact if we surface buckets in console — need growth team input.
- Validate overhead of cross-region routing on data transfer costs for EU->US spillover.

Immediate action items (owners + tickets):
- Ethan: Batch window A/B (JIRA-OPT-4312) — set experiment by 2024-11-08.
- Jamal: KV cache pilot instrumentation + top-50 prefix list (GH PR: PR-987) — measurement spec by 2024-11-12.
- Priya: Run reserved-pool sizing calc for eu-west1 13B (sheet tab: reserved-sizing) — draft by 2024-11-18.

Notes-to-self (raw):
- quick check: confirm gpu_hour numbers with infra-ratecard (discord infra-pricing).
- keep bucket thresholds flexible (maybe 32/256/1024) — test.
- low-effort: expose per-route "cost sensitivity" toggle in console for beta accounts.

Appendix: quick glossary
- slotting: mapping of model -> capacity pool (burst/shared/dedicated)
- KV cache: key-value cache for prefix/key-value cache (replay/reuse) to avoid recompute
- avg_tps: average tokens per second per GPU under given batching profile

End of draft.
